001: What do you do in your free time?
I love playing soccer with my friends on the weekend.
Oh, really? Where do you play?
At the city park, right next to my place.
That's great! Do you play often?
002: Do you have any hobbies besides soccer?
That's interesting! What do you take pictures of?
Could you show me your photos someday?
With pleasure, I'll show you my favorites.
003: Do you like reading in your free time?
Me too! Do you have a favorite author?
I read a lot of books by Fred Vargas.
I don't know her, is she good?
Yes, her stories are really captivating.
004: Do you play sports outside of work?
I go to the pool twice a week.
That's a good habit! Do you swim for a long time?
Do you prefer swimming alone or with someone?
I prefer swimming alone to relax.
005: What do you do on Sundays?
Do you want to try some someday?
Perfect, I'll invite you next Sunday.
006: Yes, I listen to a lot of jazz.
Jazz is nice! Do you have a favorite musician?
What do you listen to it on?
I mostly play vinyl records at home.
007: Do you have a creative hobby?
Yes, I draw in my free time.
That's awesome! What do you draw?
Portraits and scenes from everyday life.
Could you show me your drawings?
Of course, I have my sketchbook with me.
008: Yes, I love them with my friends.
I prefer strategy games like chess.
You must be really good then!
Not really, but I love thinking.
009: Yes, I have a small vegetable garden on my balcony.
That's a good idea! What do you grow?
Do you use those vegetables for cooking?
Yes, it's very convenient and so tasty.
010: Do you travel during your vacations?
Yes, I love discovering new regions.
Do you have a favorite place?
I really like Brittany, it's beautiful.
I go there almost every summer with my family.
